title: Candidate changes for the designer, on top of board (docs/decisions.md, Open); nothing here is decided

overrides.why: Pirate Blockade in round 1 asks 3 🟡 of players who have none, so it only adds 2 🟥 per ship at sea (8 🟥 in one game, playtest 2026-11-28, O-21); a ransom of the round number is payable early and still bites late. Tested (400 paired games, 4 players): when the event comes in rounds 1–3 it still adds 6.0 🟥, as players have no gold even for 1–3 🟡 (O-20); from round 4 it adds 3.8 🟥 instead of 2.8. It helps only once the economy gives early gold
overrides.table: Pirate Blockade: the ransom is 🟡 equal to the round number (not 3). / Пиратская блокада: выкуп — столько 🟡, каков номер тура (а не 3).

overrides.why: Bolívar's takers win 55% at 4 players (parity 25%): 4 🔔 for up to +9 🏅. At +2 they win 47%, at +1 41%; a dearer card (6 🔔) is almost never taken (5% of games). 400 paired games a point, Normal bots (playtest 2026-11-28)
overrides.table: Simón Bolívar (4 🔔): at the end, +2 🏅 for each colony you hold as a patriot (not +3). / Симон Боливар (4 🔔): в финале +2 ПО за каждую неоккупированную колонию, если вы патриот (а не +3).
